description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractExtension' in the Twig templating engine, providing default implementations for extension methods such as token parsers, node visitors, filters, tests, functions, and operators.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\AbstractExtension
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing ExtensionInterface, providing default method implementations for Twig extensions.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an empty array representing no custom token parsers by default.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an empty array representing no node visitors by default.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns an empty array representing no filters by default.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns an empty array representing no tests by default.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an empty array representing no functions by default.

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Returns an array of two empty arrays representing no operators by default.
